scope: Retained independent replacement outcomes inside one native execution/runtime boundary; production single replacement delegates group-of-one; shared ordered receipt storage preserves deletion policy
contracts: The replacement pending queue and ordered receipt ledger outlive individual child unwinding; begin precedes child consumption and successful completion immediately fills a preallocated slot
Later staging panic, pre-promotion panic, cancellation or source-version rejection preserves committed prefix receipts and exact usable inverses
Unstarted suffix reservations are explicitly retired before publication, including continued cleanup after a retirement failure; cleanup diagnostics are additive
Failed and uncertain outcomes preserve typed errors, unstarted children remain separate, and pre-promotion panic does not invent durable catalog evidence
Physical alias refresh paths are captured before child consumption, retained for started items, and deduplicated after ownership release
Runtime refresh and inventory publication contain panic and retain completed receipts; inventory errors and panics do not trigger replay or discard inverses
Deletion continues to own artifact budgets, ordinary-failure continuation, uncertainty stopping, refresh effects and terminal projection outside generic receipt storage
History and copy share ordered deduplicated diagnostics capped at32 messages and16KiB including newline separators and omission marker
